title: Add Stripe configuration status indicator with green checkmark

requirements.summary: Add visual status indicator to StripeSetup component showing Stripe configuration status with green checkmark
acceptanceCriteria: A green checkmark icon appears in the StripeSetup component when Stripe is configured
Status indicator text reads 'Stripe Configured' or similar when active
The status indicator fetches current Stripe configuration from the backend using the useStripeConfig query hook
Status updates immediately when Stripe configuration is saved

file_operations.description: Add a visual status indicator section that displays a green checkmark icon with 'Stripe Configured' text when the backend reports Stripe is configured. Use the existing useStripeConfig hook from useQueries.ts to fetch configuration status. The hook queries the isStripeConfigured() backend method which returns a boolean. Display the status indicator prominently above or near the configuration form. When the configuration is saved successfully via setStripeConfiguration mutation, the query cache invalidates automatically and the status indicator updates to show the green checkmark. Use a Check icon from lucide-react for the checkmark visual. Style the indicator with green color scheme to match success state (e.g., text-green-600, bg-green-50).
